title: Ava's Garden Experiment
introLine: Welcome to the garden lab, Ava! Let's discover how plants and animals work together.
closingLine: Now it is your turn to help the garden grow! Match the helpers to their jobs.

scenes.title: The Busy Bee's Mission
scenes.narration: Ava watches a fuzzy bee land on a bright sunflower. As the bee sips nectar, yellow pollen sticks to its legs. When it flies to the next flower, it helps the plant make new seeds!
scenes.imagePrompt: A polished 2D illustration of a smiling fuzzy bumblebee landing on a vibrant yellow sunflower in a sunny garden, soft colors, no text.

scenes.title: The Squirrel's Secret
scenes.narration: Look at that squirrel! It hides a crunchy acorn in the soft soil. Sometimes squirrels forget where they hide them, and those seeds grow into tall oak trees. Animals help spread seeds far and wide.
scenes.imagePrompt: A cute squirrel burying an acorn in rich brown soil near a garden fence, colorful autumn leaves, polished 2D game art style, no text.
